Name: It's My Farm I'll Pass Out If I Want To
Author: Apprehentice
Description:
Pass out on your farm for minimal (or no) consequences! Do you think the denizens of Pelican Town should mind their own business? Do you hate how they police where and when you pass out on your own property? Do you find it kind of creepy that Maurice breaks into your house to tuck you into bed and then charge you for it? Install this mod and they'll leave you alone for once.

This mod is more or less a fork, a recreation, or a successor of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6247]Exhaustion Tweaks[/url]. When you pass out in a safe location, this mod prevents the game from taking your gold. It then applies a configurable stamina penalty (sleeping on the ground sucks) before placing you at or as close to the location you were previously at. Yes, that includes the mines, if you have it configured to do so. All configuration is done in the config.json file next to the mod. Run the game once to generate a fresh one. There is no menu at this time, but perhaps later.

[u]Config Options
[/u]
[b]FarmIsSafe[/b] - Default: true - Treats the farm as well as all farm buildings and interiors as safe.

[b]AllIsSafe[/b] - Default: false - Treats all locations as safe

[b]WakeInBed[/b] - Default: false - Wake up in your bed instead of warping back to your previous location when the day starts

[b]StaminaDivisor[/b] - Default: 2 - Stamina is divided by this number when you pass out in a safe location

[b]AdditionalSafeLocations[/b] - Default: [] - A list of [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Location_data#Location_names]Location Names[/url] which will be treated as safe
